preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ,.!?' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Every character in stdin is a lowercase Latin letter, space, or one of the punctuation marks: comma, dot, exclamation mark, or question mark.
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.
The length of stdin is at most 10000 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: Every space in stdout separates two Latin letters (i.e., is between two words) and is not at the start or end of the line.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' or (stdout[i] in ',.!?' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] != ' ')) for i in range(len(stdout)))
postconditions.description: No space appears immediately before any punctuation mark in stdout.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in ',.!?' and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] == ' ') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] in ',.!?')
postconditions.description: Every punctuation mark in stdout is followed by exactly one space, except if it is the last character.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] in ',.!?') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: No space appears immediately after a punctuation mark except as a single space following it (unless it is the last character).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' and (i == 0 or stdout[i-1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') and (i == len(stdout)-1 or stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: Every space in stdout separates exactly one pair of words (no multiple spaces between words).

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join([stdin[0], *[' ' if (stdin[i] in ',.!?' and stdin[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') else '' for i in range(len(stdin)-1)], *[' ' if (stdin[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and stdin[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and all(stdin[j] not in ',.!?' for j in range(i+1))) else '' for i in range(len(stdin)-1)]])
postconditions.description: The output is constructed by ensuring exactly one space between words with no intervening punctuation, and exactly one space after each punctuation mark (unless it is the last character).
